channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran says negotiations with Oman over Strait of Hormuz in final stages
item.description: Tehran's announcement comes after Trump said US would hold off on new Iran attack in hope of quick deal.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attacks kill eight in response to Russian missiles
item.description: Ukrainian strikes target Russian oil hubs and high-rises as Zelenskyy warns of critical Patriot interceptor shortages.

item.title: ‘Iron fist’ doesn’t work with Iran: Former US hostage in Tehran
item.description: Former US hostage John Limbert says Washington ‘can’t bomb and assassinate its way to a better relationship’ with Iran.

item.title: Fetus found among the ruins of a deadly Israeli strike on Gaza
item.description: Residents searching through the rubble of an Israeli strike in western Gaza City recovered the body of an unborn baby.

item.title: Migrant deaths in Ceuta rise to 72 after border surge from Morocco
item.description: Five more bodies have been found along Ceuta's coastline as enclave recovers from unprecedented border influx.

item.title: ‘Iran war participation trophy’ mocking Trump appears in New York
item.description: A 10-foot-tall golden trophy mocking US President Donald Trump for the Iran war has appeared in New York.

item.title: Deadly floods and landslide hit India’s Kerala
item.description: At least two people have been killed and eight injured after torrential rain triggered flooding

item.title: Saudi Crown Prince MBS urges Trump to ‘prioritise dialogue’ in US-Iran war
item.description: US president halted strikes after earlier threatening Iran with unprecedented force.

item.title: Heatwave forces nuclear shutdown in Hungary
item.description: Hungary says a heatwave has forced the shutdown of its largest nuclear plant as low Danube levels disrupt cooling.

item.title: No breakthrough on Strait of Hormuz as Trump halts attack on Iran
item.description: Iran says Trump's comment on pullback from threatened strikes made 'within the context of psychological operations'.
